# Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2006

**Approving the Petition of Pitogo Van Association to Temporarily Ply the Route of Pototanin (Pitogo)-Lucena and Vice-Versa**

## Summary

This ordinance approves the petition of the [[Pitogo Van Association]] to temporarily operate the Pototanin (Pitogo)-Lucena route and vice-versa. It establishes regulations for the operation of vans, including business tax, payment schedules, discounts for senior citizens and students, fare display, pick-up points, and a separability clause. The ordinance takes effect immediately upon approval.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** This ordinance shall be known as the ordinance approving the petition of [[Pitogo Van Association]] to temporarily ply the route of Pototanin (Pitogo)-Lucena and vice-versa.
2.  **Section 2.** Business Tax - For purposes of this ordinance, there shall be collected a business tax in the amount of FIVE HUNDRED PESOS (₱ 500.00) every month changeable to the PVA.
3.  **Section 3.** Time of Payment - The tax shall be paid to the Office of the Treasurer every last day of the month.
4.  **Section 4.** Late Payment - Failure to pay the tax prescribed within the time required shall be subject to a surcharge of TWENTY FIVE PERCENT (25%) of the amount due.
5.  **Section 5.** Discount on Passengers - The following persons (with I.D.) will be given TEN PERCENT (10%) discount:
    1.  Senior Citizens
    2.  Students
6.  **Section 6.** Fare - The fare shall be prominently displayed in every van and shall be announced from time to time before travel to any point of destinations by the driver or dispatcher/barker.
7.  **Section 7.** Pick-up Point - There will be no pick-up point in the town proper.
8.  **Section 8.** Separability Clause - If for any reason, any section or provision of this ordinance shall be held unconstitutional or invalid by competent authority, such judgment or action shall not affect or impair other sections or provisions thereof.
9.  **Section 9.** Repealing Clause - Any ordinance rules and regulations in conflict with or inconsistent with this ordinance is hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
10. **Section 10.** Effectivity - This ordinance shall take effect immediately upon approval.

## Entities

- [[Pitogo Van Association]] — Petitioner
- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] — Legislative body
- [[Office of the Treasurer]] — Receiving office for tax payments
- [[Joselito L. Jaranilla]] — Vice-Mayor (Presiding Officer)
- [[Domingo I. Tan]] — Municipal Mayor
